comment: Node-typed test lane. Most tests run under tsconfig.app.json, which ships
ONLY vite/client types on purpose so app code can't reach for node APIs.
A few gates must read committed files from disk (e.g. the atlas VRAM budget
reads the real atlas PNG headers). Those are named `*.node.test.ts`, are
excluded from the app project, and compile here WITH node types — so the
file-reading stays quarantined to the gate and never leaks node globals into
